at Kyowa Kirin International plc
Milan – Italy 
 
WE PUSH THE BOUNDARIES OF MEDICINE. 
 
LEAPING FORWARD TO MAKE PEOPLE SMILE 
 
At Kyowa Kirin International (KKI), our purpose is to make people smile. This means more than drug discovery and development; it is about embedding care into everything we do to make a difference every day for those that need it most. We’re an inclusive pharmaceutical company that takes time to understand what really matters to our patients, their families, and their healthcare professionals, helping our people to take bold actions that deliver life-changing solutions sooner. Our culture is rooted in our values: Teamwork, Commitment to Life, Innovation, and Integrity. They help us to push boundaries to deliver extraordinary impact and make KKI a brilliant place to work.
 
Job Purpose
 
Lead the cluster marketing strategy for Crysvita and Poteligeo, driving growth and improving patient outcomes across the region. This role oversees the marketing team, shapes the cluster roadmap in alignment with global and regional priorities, and delivers impactful local initiatives that support customers, patients, and KKI’s business objectives.
 
As the commercial marketing leader, you will define strategy and ensure flawless execution across affiliates and commercial partners, while maintaining the highest standards of compliance. Working closely with Medical, Market Access, Field, Digital/Omnichannel, regional and global marketing teams, and the Cluster General Manager, you will create and deliver a forward-looking vision that maximizes brand success and patient impact across the cluster." />
